What are microlink extensions?

Microlinks nyc extensions are individual strands of extensions that are attached to your own hair using small non-damaging aluminum beads. The method is light & perfect for growing out your hair.

What are the pros & cons of microlink extensions?

The pros to using this type of extensions is you can easily run your fingers through your hair at the scalp unlike with natural beaded row or invisible beaded row extensions. the luxe aura european brand hair extensions can be re-used up to one (1) year or more. while there are very few pros to this method two major factors to consider is the microlink strands, also called i-tips, can slide off the hair if not applied or maintained properly. for this reason, it is important to choose the best hair extensions salon nyc for your application and maintenance of your microlink hair extensions.

am i a good candidate for microlink extensions?

what length hair is good formicrolink extensions?

These are very common questions and while the answers vary based on each guest’s unique hair needs and situation, below are some simple guidelines for determining if you are a good candidate for microlink extensions.

  • You are growing out a short/bad haircut.

  • You have medium volume hair.

  • You have at least 3 - 4 inches of your own hair.

  • You are seeking to add highlights, volume, and/or length to your own hair.

  • You are not experiencing rapid loss of hair.

  • You want to disguise damaged, over-processed hair while adapting a healthy hair regime.

can you wash your hair with microlink extensions?

How do you wash microlink extensions?

Yes, your hair can be washed, styled, processed, etc. while you have hair extensions installed onto your hair.

how much do microlink extensions cost?

While a consultation is recommended to determine the amount of microlink extensions length, and color that will be required for YOUR new hair extensions application packages generally start at $650+, including our luxurious human european hair.
